sloka: अद्य राज्ये ऽभिषेक्ष्यामि भरतं धर्मवत्सलम् ।अयोध्यायाः पतिं वीरं ततो यास्याम्यहं वनम् ।। ७.१०७.२ ॥
transliteration: adya rājye 'bhiṣekṣyāmi bharataṁ dharmavatsalam ।ayodhyāyāḥ patiṁ vīraṁ tato yāsyāmyahaṁ vanam ।। 7.107.2 ॥

translations.english: Rama declared, "Today I shall install the righteous and brave Bharata as the ruler of Ayodhya, and then I myself shall go to the forest."
